text.p: Wall Street stocks were expected to move higher at the start of trading Monday following through on Friday's rally.
With no important economic data due out, investors will take heart from the fact that fears about interest rates were soothed for the time being last week and that European markets are mostly higher.
"European markets are higher, the dollar is weaker and the bond market is up somewhat," said Peter Cardillo, director of researrch at Westfalia Investments.
